title: Wedding Party Outdoors in Garden, 1920s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: An intimate late 1920s outdoor snapshot depicting a wedding trio standing on a grassy lawn in front of lush garden bushes and trees. On the right, the bride wears a knee-length drop-waist wedding gown, a draped shawl neckline, floral headband, and holds a bridal bouquet. In the center, the groom wears a three-piece suit with a lapel boutonnière and wire-rimmed spectacles. To the left, a woman—likely a bridesmaid, sister, or mother—dons a patterned floral drop-waist dress, eyeglasses, and a matching corsage. The 1920s bobbed haircuts and hemlines showcase the quintessential styles of the Roaring Twenties jazz age.
